capabilities: Scaffold a PARA/Zettelkasten vault layout with templates and dashboards
Ingest sources and syntheses into interlinked wiki notes via LLM skills
Reorganize and lint the generated wiki topology
Expose the workflow contract through a native CLI and an MCP server for edit tools
Provide GUI commands and ribbon shortcuts for projects, areas, resources, ZK and daily notes
extras: Detailed usage docs live outside the README (docs/MCP.md, docs/CLI.md); CLI/MCP values are locale-neutral codes with optional non-English locales such as locale=ko.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in PARA/Zettelkasten workflow that keeps frontmatter, references and backlinks coherent while LLM agents ingest sources into the vault.

relations.evidence: exposes the full workflow contract through a native CLI. Its thin MCP server discovers that CLI contract

requires.name: Claude Code or Codex (or another MCP client) plus a CLI on PATH

summary: AI-maintained PARA and Zettelkasten knowledge wiki that scaffolds vault structure and exposes workflows to LLM clients via CLI and MCP.
